command:
set -eu
echo SSB_REGISTRATION_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
awk '$1=="sdp_pqe_frc" {print}' /proc/modules
if test -d /sys/module/sdp_pqe_frc; then
 echo MODULE_SYSFS_PRESENT
 for n in initstate refcnt; do
  if test -r /sys/module/sdp_pqe_frc/$n; then echo "$n"; cat /sys/module/sdp_pqe_frc/$n; fi
 done
 if test -d /sys/module/sdp_pqe_frc/drivers; then ls -l /sys/module/sdp_pqe_frc/drivers; fi
else
 echo MODULE_SYSFS_ABSENT
fi
for p in /dev/ssb* /sys/class/usbmisc/ssb* /sys/bus/usb/drivers/*ssb*; do
 if test -e "$p"; then echo PRESENT; ls -ld "$p"; fi
done
echo USB_CACHED_DEVICE_METADATA
for d in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
 if test -r "$d/idVendor" && test -r "$d/idProduct"; then
  echo "USB_DEVICE=$d"
  for n in idVendor idProduct product manufacturer bcdDevice; do
   if test -r "$d/$n"; then echo "$n"; cat "$d/$n"; fi
  done
  if test -L "$d/driver"; then echo DRIVER; readlink -f "$d/driver"; fi
 fi
done
echo SSB_REGISTRATION_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: module/sysfs/USB cached descriptor metadata only; no opens/control/register
